digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI workflow / GitHub Actions
propositions: Gerrit Verified wall-clock duration regressed from 15–20 minutes to 30–40 minutes; macOS execution median increased to 27.0m with p90 at 30.68m plus mean queue time of 4.04m.

Test suite grew by ~4.1k selected default tests adding 91,205 test lines; macOS default tier pytest increased 870.72s from Aug 1 baseline to current, with Aug 1 top-25 tests summing to 193.32s and current summing to 497.86s.

Five specific unit tests execute expensive mechanics with real-time waits (120s Jira readiness budget, five 5s captured sleeps, 25s retry loop, 15s backoff/timeout) that are not required for coverage; focused A/B testing proved elimination preserves assertions.

Wiki corpus test introduced per-xdist-worker LRU cache recomputation (321.6–495.6s aggregate across five tests); process-local single-session fill would reduce to 23.26s while preserving 178 real pandoc bodies and all assertions.

Mutation testing landed 2026-08-12 but was skipped in 57 of 62 post-landing runs and added 0m to measured critical path; active-mutation runs averaged 33.0m vs skipped-runs 36.5m, rejecting mutation as direct regression cause.

macOS/process contention amplifies deterministic work under GitHub Free org limits (5 macOS jobs); same post-wiki test set varied 20m07s to 33m51s, indicating nonlinear subprocess/APFS workload sensitivity rather than editor startup overhead.
